provenance.construction: One [[6,4,2]] distance-amplification step (Liang, Gu, Chen, Eisert, Wang, arXiv:2609.37231, Eqs. (14), (15); amplifier checks G_X = G_Z = the all-one row of length 6) applied to the board entry codes/90-14-11.json ([[90,14,11]] two-block code over a group of order 45; d_X = d_Z = 11 certified in certs/90-14-11.json), keeping all of its checks.X except the rows [2, 9, 16, 17, 34, 40, 44] and all of its checks.Z except the rows [3, 9, 21, 23, 30, 39, 44] (linearly independent, 38 and 38 rows). Qubits: central (q,a) -> 6q+a (q a base qubit, 0 <= a < 6); t_j -> 540+j for the j-th kept Z-check z_j; s_i -> 578+i for the i-th kept X-check c_i. X-checks: (c_i,a) = {6q+a : q in c_i} + {s_i} (i, then a), then (q) = {6q,...,6q+5} + {t_j : q in z_j} (q = 0..89); Z-checks: (z_j,a) = {6q+a : q in z_j} + {t_j}, then (q) = {6q,...,6q+5} + {s_i : q in c_i}. n = 6*90 + 38 + 38 = 616 = 7n - k of the base, k = 4*14 = 56, check weight 12.
provenance.notes: Distance: d_X = d_Z = 22 exactly: d_P = 2 d_P(base) for P = X, Z by Lemma 4 of arXiv:2609.37231 (proof in the coordinates of this entry: Proposition 4 of amplified-and-folded-codes/README.md, github.com/TimoKellerMath/quantum-error-correction @ c203901854da), and d_X = d_Z = 11 for the base is certified in certs/90-14-11.json (tropidist b03ec2d4077f, level solver). Witnesses: u (x) (e_0 + e_1) for the witnesses u of codes/90-14-11.json. Filed as upper_bound with these witnesses: the board earns the exact tier only through certs/, and its certifiers do not reach d = 22 at k = 56. The construction and the base are published; at board commit 8042f9da no CSS entry dominates or equals this code in (n, k, d, w), and no entry has its n and k unless named here; checked, not equivalent to an existing entry.
